nodes.label: Small Enforcement Core + Self-Triggering References
nodes.rationale: Three-tier loading (metadata always, body on trigger, references on demand) with hard token budgets keeps the always-on core enforcement-dense while heavy technique content stays on-demand.

nodes.label: Trigger-Engineering of Descriptions
nodes.rationale: A documented test showed agents executing the description's workflow summary instead of loading the body, so descriptions must contain only triggering conditions and violation symptoms, never a summary.

nodes.label: Claim-to-Evidence Table with Not-Sufficient Column
nodes.rationale: Pre-enumerating the counterfeit proxy a model would otherwise accept (e.g. 'code changed, assumed fixed') turns the table into a checklist a verifier can run.

nodes.label: Gate Function + Freshness Scoping
nodes.rationale: Forcing step 1 to name the proving command makes 'no command exists / didn't run it' explicit; the freshness rule mechanically defeats stale-result reuse after edits.

nodes.label: Rationalization Tables + Lexical Tripwires
nodes.rationale: Weaker models emit the same 10-12 stock excuse phrases, so a counter keyed to the exact token being generated collides with the excuse as it's produced.

nodes.label: Machine-Checkable Predicates
nodes.rationale: Data-dependency sequencing, where each step's output feeds the next step's branch condition, makes skipping a step structurally impossible, stronger than any prose 'do not skip'.

nodes.label: Iron Law Form
nodes.rationale: A rule with no legal exit gets abandoned wholesale when it's genuinely wrong, so exactly one human-gated or taxed escape valve is required; scarcity of Iron Laws (2-3 total) is the mechanism that keeps them salient.

nodes.label: Calibrated Skeptic Reviewer
nodes.rationale: Composes inoculation against trusting the implementer's report, a calibration floor with two-lane verdicts to avoid both rubber-stamping and infinite nitpicking, a three-valued verdict, and a format that makes vagueness syntactically illegal.

nodes.label: Quantified Circuit Breaker
nodes.rationale: Models can't judge 'am I thrashing?' but can count to 3; reframing escalation as 'wrong architecture' rather than 'failed hypothesis' makes the exit feel like insight so it actually gets taken.

nodes.label: Sanctioned Failure Channel
nodes.rationale: Fabricated success disappears when honest failure has a first-class typed output format (DONE/DONE_WITH_CONCERNS/BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT) with explicit non-penalization.

nodes.label: Falsification Ritual (Revert-and-Rerun)
nodes.rationale: The reverted run either failed or it didn't, making this the only unfakeable proof that a regression test actually guards the fix.

nodes.label: Zero-Context Questionable-Taste Reader Persona
nodes.rationale: Defining the artifact's reader as having zero codebase context makes completeness self-derived: the model literally cannot write vague filler like 'add appropriate error handling' for that reader.

nodes.label: Constructed Context + Capped Returns + File Handoffs
nodes.rationale: An explained cost model ('everything pasted stays resident and is re-read every turn') lets the model generalize the rule to unlisted cases, unlike a bare imperative.

nodes.label: Pre-Response Sequencing Gate
nodes.rationale: Ordering the routing check before any output, including clarifying questions, closes the 'I need context first' rationalization hatch; the scripted announcement exploits autoregressive self-consistency and doubles as telemetry.

nodes.label: Degrees-of-Freedom Calibration
nodes.rationale: Matches instruction specificity to fragility: 'narrow bridge with cliffs' operations get verbatim scripts and zero freedom, 'open field' work gets heuristics only.

nodes.label: Pressure Inoculation
nodes.rationale: Without inverting urgency into stricter compliance, urgency signals in the prompt act as implicit permission to skip every gate downstream.

nodes.label: Colocated Invariants
nodes.rationale: Models honor the code block they're copying after they've stopped honoring surrounding prose, so gotchas must be repeated inline at every usage site, not stated once.

nodes.label: Baseline-First Empirical Authoring + Adversarial Pressure-Testing
nodes.rationale: If a no-guidance control run doesn't fail, the rule shouldn't be authored; wording is validated with 5+ fresh-context reps and stacked-pressure adversarial scenarios.

nodes.label: Checklist to Externalized Todo
nodes.rationale: Prose checklists fall out of effective context beyond ~3 tool calls; harness state survives context rot where prose does not.

nodes.label: Announcement (Commitment Device)
nodes.rationale: Near-zero cost, exploits self-consistency, and provides telemetry, but must never be relied on alone since it's unverified.

nodes.label: Verbatim Script + Turn Isolation
nodes.rationale: Scripting the blocked message as its own message that must wait for a response converts a decorative ask into a hard stop and makes refusal a completable turn.

nodes.label: Closed Menu (State-Dependent)
nodes.rationale: Invalid actions are removed before the choice is presented, eliminating the undisciplined exit edge where improvisation is the failure mode.

nodes.label: Declaration Audit
nodes.rationale: Blanket bans break legitimate work and blanket freedom invites creep, so boundary crossings are permitted only if each is individually named in the output.

nodes.label: Format-Forced Cognition
nodes.rationale: An output grammar requiring a verdict, finding with file:line, or named check for every permitted line makes laziness syntactically illegal.

nodes.label: Calibration Floor + Two-Lane Output
nodes.rationale: 'Approve unless serious gaps' plus splitting blocking Issues from advisory Recommendations defuses both rubber-stamping and infinite nitpicking.

nodes.label: Ergonomic Compliance (Scripts)
nodes.rationale: Compliance by making the correct path less typing than the shortcut; must be cross-platform to hold.

nodes.label: Cheap Bounded Gate
nodes.rationale: Capping the gate's cost removes the only argument for skipping it, so the gate stays fixed while its ceremony scales down.

nodes.label: Pre-Scripted Degradation
nodes.rationale: Without an authored failure path for predictable environmental failures (e.g. sandbox denial), models retry-loop or improvise dangerously.

nodes.label: Redundant Encoding
nodes.rationale: Carries roughly 40% token overhead, so it scales terribly as a default and should be reserved for irreversible operations only.

nodes.label: Enforcement Toolbox
nodes.rationale: Governing principle: match the form to the failure — prohibitions for discipline violations, recipes for wrong-shaped output, structural slots for omissions, observable-predicate conditionals for conditional behavior.

nodes.label: Skeptic-Verification Module
nodes.rationale: The module superpowers half-built and orphaned; the replacement system makes it first-class.

nodes.label: Baseline-First QA / Build Methodology Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Not runtime content — a pipeline for building and maintaining dispatcher rules and playbook modules; test artifacts stay out of runtime directories.

nodes.label: No Proportionality Anywhere
nodes.rationale: Absolutes overkill for trivial cases train the model and user to disable the whole system; escalation criteria must be mechanical, never based on how complex a task feels

nodes.label: Honor-System Enforcement, Zero Detection
nodes.rationale: Nothing verifies announcements, reading, todo creation, or that tests actually ran; a silent skipper faces no consequence, so critical gates must be backed by machine checks

nodes.label: Self-Violation of Its Own Budgets
nodes.rationale: A system that visibly breaks its own rules invites the model to discount all of them; module budgets need a runnable build-time check

nodes.label: Salience Inflation
nodes.rationale: MUST/ABSOLUTELY/EXTREMELY-IMPORTANT as ambient register stops discriminating priority and contradicts the system's own persuasion guidance; caps-lock authority should appear only in Iron Laws

nodes.label: Uncalibrated 1% Invocation Threshold
nodes.rationale: With a large inventory every task clears 1% for something, and constant invocation overhead is the pressure that later drives silent defection; deterministic classification should replace threshold-based recall

nodes.label: Fabricated Statistics and Threat Framing
nodes.rationale: Unverifiable numbers and threats are persuasive until questioned, then discredit the whole document; keep the honesty reframe and real anecdotes, drop the fabricated statistics

nodes.label: Duplication with Drift
nodes.rationale: Divergent duplicate rules become a rationalization wedge; each gate should live in exactly one canonical place with modules referencing rather than restating it

nodes.label: Dead Wiring
nodes.rationale: Every artifact must be reachable from a runtime path or deleted, verified at build time

nodes.label: Rigor Inverted at the End
nodes.rationale: The final merge-gate reviewer is the most trusting prompt with no inoculation, scope fence, or evidence requirement, while execution got none of planning's enforcement machinery; rigor must peak at integration, not authoring

nodes.label: POSIX-Only, Harness-Assuming Tooling
nodes.rationale: All probes assume bash and a git repo; once mechanical predicates break on other platforms the model reverts to the improvisation the system exists to prevent

nodes.label: Unhandled Likely Failures
nodes.rationale: No dirty-tree check, no merge-conflict path, naive test-runner guessing under the load-bearing completion gate; script the probable failure, not just the exotic one

nodes.label: Dev Artifacts in Runtime Directories
nodes.rationale: Build-time and runtime content must live in separate trees so naive loaders are not burdened with dev-only content

nodes.label: Over-Broad Token Bans
nodes.rationale: Blanket bans create a broken-window effect; lexical bans should scope to the exact context where the token predicts the failure

nodes.label: Interactivity Assumptions
nodes.rationale: Consent questions assume a human is present, leaving the safest-critical moments the least automated in orchestrated runs; every human gate needs a non-interactive default-deny plus BLOCKED report

nodes.label: Unresolved Tension with User-Level Instructions
nodes.rationale: Mandating ceremony on every task conflicts with a minimal-ceremony CLAUDE.md, leaving the model to arbitrate silently; proportional escalation resolves this since low tiers are near-zero ceremony by contract

nodes.label: Gaps — What the New System Must Build
Task Classification (Dispatcher Front-End)
nodes.rationale: Superpowers has no classifier and relies on the model voluntarily recognizing task type, which fails under pressure; an always-on classification step must map requests to task type via observable signals before the first response token

nodes.label: Proportional Risk Escalation
nodes.rationale: Nothing in superpowers scales with stakes; a risk-tier function from mechanical inputs should select instruction freedom, mandatory gates, gate depth, and checkpoint frequency, with de-escalation never self-granted

nodes.label: Skeptic Verification of Execution Output
nodes.rationale: Superpowers reviews documents but trusts executed code to self-reported verification, and its final merge reviewer is its weakest prompt; a first-class skeptic module must apply at every completion boundary with rigor increasing toward merge

nodes.label: Evidence Artifacts and Machine-Checkable Completion Gates
nodes.rationale: Superpowers never requires capturing evidence, so an unverified claim formally satisfies it; every claim must carry pasted command, exit code, and relevant output, checkable by a dumb program

nodes.label: Supporting Infrastructure Superpowers Lacks
nodes.rationale: A canonical probe library, test-runner discovery procedure, non-interactive defaults, model/agent-tier binding, build-time QA pipeline, and budget linting must all be built before any dispatcher rule ships

hyperedges.label: Patterns placed in the Dispatcher Core
Patterns forming the Completion Gates layer
